name: Horde Breakers
subtitle: Co-op Zombie Survival FPS
promotionalText: Season 1: Black Harvest is live! Squad up with up to 3 friends, beat today's Daily Challenge and fight your way up the Ranked leagues to Legend.
description:
The dead don't stop. Neither do you.

Horde Breakers is a wave-based zombie survival shooter built for iPhone and iPad. Grab up to three friends, hold the line and see how long your squad can last.

SURVIVE TOGETHER — 4-PLAYER ONLINE CO-OP
Invite friends through Game Center and fight side by side. Cover each other, revive downed teammates and split the horde between you. Every wave gets harder; every win feels earned.

A NEW DAILY CHALLENGE EVERY DAY
Same seed, same map and the same guns for every survivor on Earth. One run, one leaderboard, no excuses. A fresh challenge drops at 00:00 UTC.

RANKED WEEKLY
Climb from Bronze through Silver, Gold, Platinum and Diamond all the way to Legend. Get promoted, avoid relegation and collect weekly league rewards — including a Diamond-only weapon skin you keep for as long as you stay Diamond or above.

SPRINT 20
How fast can you clear wave 20? Race the clock and post your time on the SPRINT 20 leaderboard.

FOUR MAPS, FOUR MONSTROUS BOSSES
Fight through the Street, the Dead Mall, the Overpass and the Military Base. Then face the Abomination, the Butcher, the Plague King and the Goliath.

BUILD YOUR RUN
Pick an upgrade after every wave, with major game-changing upgrades every 10th wave. No two runs play the same.

MASTER YOUR WEAPONS
Level up every gun, earn Prestige stars and unlock animated prestige skins that show everyone how many zombies you've put down.

MAKE YOUR SURVIVOR
A deep character creator with outfits and weapon skins you unlock simply by levelling up.

SEASONS & LIVE EVENTS
Every season brings a new Season Pass track full of rewards. Buying the pass unlocks the season's exclusive outfit instantly — it's cosmetic only, so nobody can pay to win. On weekends, live events like Blood Moon, Scrap Rush, Headhunter and Horde Night bring twists and event-only rewards.

BETTER WITH FRIENDS
Invite a friend and you both get the exclusive "Blood Brothers" outfit. Been away a while? A comeback bonus is waiting for you.

25 Game Center achievements to hunt.

No ads. No tracking. No data collected. Just you, your squad and the horde.
